import sys, wave, numpy as np
w = wave.open(sys.argv[1]); sr = w.getframerate(); n = w.getnframes()

x = np.where(x >= 1<<23, x - (1<<24), x) / float(1<<23)
x = x.reshape(-1, 2); dry, wet = x[:,0], x[:,1]
db = lambda v: 20*np.log10(max(v,1e-9))
for name, s in (("dry", dry), ("wet", wet)):
    d = np.diff(s)
    # clicks: sample jump far larger than local typical jump
    loc = np.convolve(np.abs(d), np.ones(64)/64, mode="same") + 1e-6
    clicks = np.where((np.abs(d) > 12*loc) & (np.abs(d) > 0.02))[0]
    # exact-zero runs (dropouts) of >= 16 samples in non-silent passages
    z = (s == 0).astype(int); runs = 0; r = 0
    for v in z:
        r = r+1 if v else 0
        if r == 16: runs += 1
    print(f"{name}: peak {db(np.abs(s).max()):6.1f} dBFS  rms {db(np.sqrt((s**2).mean())):6.1f} dBFS  "
          f"clipped {(np.abs(s) >= 0.999).sum():6d}  clicks {len(clicks):5d}  zero-runs {runs}")
    if len(clicks): print("   first click times (s):", np.round(clicks[:12]/sr, 3))
print("sr", sr, "len", round(n/sr,2), "s")
EOF
